definitions.gloss: occurring one after another, successive occurrence
definitions.explanation: Events, incidents, or problems arising in succession over a period of time. Typically used for negative events such as accidents, crimes, or complications.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}が{続発|ぞくはつ}した。
この{地域|ちいき}では{窃盗|せっとう}{事件|じけん}が{続発|ぞくはつ}している。
examples.english: Theft cases keep occurring one after another in this area.

examples.japanese: {術後|じゅつご}に{合併症|がっぺいしょう}が{続発|ぞくはつ}したため、{入院|にゅういん}{期間|きかん}が{延|の}びた。
examples.english: Because complications arose one after another after the surgery, the hospital stay was extended.

notes:
Almost exclusively used for negative events — accidents, crimes, complications, disasters, and similar problems. Unlike {連発|れんぱつ}, which can describe any rapid repetition including positive things, {続発|ぞくはつ} strongly implies a troubling pattern of incidents arising in sequence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}が{続発|ぞくはつ}する: accidents occur in succession
- {事件|じけん}が{続発|ぞくはつ}する: incidents occur one after another
- {合併症|がっぺいしょう}が{続発|ぞくはつ}する: complications arise in succession
- {被害|ひがい}が{続発|ぞくはつ}する: damage/harm keeps occurring

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連発|れんぱつ}: rapid repetition — same action repeated in quick succession; can be positive or negative
- {頻発|ひんぱつ}: frequent occurrence — emphasizes high frequency, less focus on sequential pattern
- {多発|たはつ}: frequent occurrence — similar to {頻発|ひんぱつ} but more neutral/statistical
